card.name: Scattered words in technical prose
card.fires_on: No single word or setting is shared. It fires on scattered tokens such as a digit inside a number, 'of', 'from', or partway through a technical name, in science text.

modes.label: Digits in numbers
modes.description: A leading digit inside a shuttle mission number or a century-style year.
modes.example: After STS-<<1>>21's safe conclusion, NASA deemed

modes.label: Linking words in science prose
modes.description: Small words like 'of' or 'from' in explanatory science sentences.
modes.example: possibly all,<< of>> the electromagnetic spectrum.

modes.label: Inside technical names
modes.description: Partway through a chemical or organism name.
modes.example: did not alter the pharmacokinetics of<< mic>>afungin for injection.
